package.description: Cross-platform MCP (Model Context Protocol) proxy tool

en-US.description: Cross-platform MCP (Model Context Protocol) proxy tool
en-US.longDescription: A command-line proxy tool that forwards Model Context Protocol (MCP) requests to HTTP, STDIO, or named pipe-based MCP servers. Supports multiple transport modes and cross-platform operation. This Windows package provides the native Windows executable with proper permissions and path integration.
en-US.name: MCP Proxy Tool
